_comment: Template for: scripts/install.sh --unattended ./install.json
Copy this file, edit it, and delete the _comment key (it is ignored either way).
db.type                  'bundled' (the Postgres in docker-compose.yml) or 'external'.
'external' additionally needs host, port, dbname, user and a
password — supply the password via the SCF_DB_PASSWORD
environment variable or --db-password-stdin, never in this
file. An external database is connected and validated BEFORE
anything is written.
idp.type                 'bundled_keycloak', 'external_oidc' or 'none'.
idp.bootstrap_admin_email  REQUIRED for 'bundled_keycloak'. The account install.sh --up
promotes to platform administrator. Omit it and provisioning
is refused before anything is written.
idp.oidc_client_secret   only for 'external_oidc' — a secret owned by a system that is
not ours, so it is the one credential you may supply.
storage.type             'bundled_minio' (the default, and what every install got before
this key existed) or 'none'. 'none' is the same choice as the
--no-minio flag: the minio and minio-init services are left out
of the stack entirely and evidence storage is configured
afterwards from Settings. Supplying BOTH this key and the flag
with different values is refused rather than resolved.
